name: Kekkonshikijou
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional wedding hall (Hanamusubi Wedding Hall): a notice about the photo-corner setup, a first day helping at the reception desk, an open-house guide, a notice about a bridal consultation day discount, a guide to the booking process, a reflection on learning from a couple's planning meeting, a report on teaching a new staff member how to emcee, an essay on why weekday weddings increased, a rainy-day contingency guide, a column on the diversifying styles of weddings, a notice of revised cancellation rules, a reflection on what a ceremony still carries, and a one-year cooperation report on a partnership with local flower shops. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
